title_en: Notice on Changing the Grading Method for Common Curriculum Courses Offered in the 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: This notice announces the period and procedure for changing the grading method for eligible Common Curriculum (공통교육과정) courses offered in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year. The period, procedure, and list of eligible courses are given only in the two attached files, which were not read.
translation:
Title: Notice on Changing the Grading Method for Common Curriculum Courses Offered in the 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year

Posted: 2026-08-31

This notice announces the period and method for changing the grading method (성적평가방법) for those Common Curriculum (공통교육과정) courses offered in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year whose grading method may be changed.

Attachment 1. List of Courses Eligible for a Change of Grading Method, 2nd Semester of 2026 ([붙임1] 2026. 2학기 성적평가방법 변경 가능 강좌 목록.xlsx, 23 KB)

Attachment 2. Manual for Changing the Grading Method of Common Curriculum Courses ([붙임2] 공통교육과정 교과목 성적평가방법 변경 매뉴얼.hwp, 282 KB)

[Translator's note: The text of the notice does not state the change period, the procedure, or which courses are eligible. This information appears to be contained in the two attachments, which were not read and are not translated here. Please download the attachments from the original notice or contact the department office; contact details are in the original notice.]
